name: loginauthentication
description: Full-stack authentication system with JWT, bcrypt, React (Vite) client and Node.js/Express + MongoDB server.

scripts.install:all: npm run install:server && npm run install:client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.build:netlify: npm install --prefix server --omit=dev && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
